sources.snippet: The IFX MCUboot PSE84 middleware is an Infineon-maintained ModusToolbox library based on the MCUboot project, specifically adapted for PSOC™ Edge PSE84 microcontrollers. This middleware provides the core components and APIs needed to build secure bootloader applications for PSE84 devices.
